How it trades. Holds by default. In a range-bound market it steps aside when prices are stretched above average and returns when they come back.

Research thesis. Hold the equal-weight basket by default. Only when the basket's trailing mean-reversion speed says the market is range-bound, step aside once it is stretched above its rolling mean and buy back when it has come back. In trending or random-walk markets it never sells, so it is buy-and-hold plus a bounded bet.
